name: TOHOTOPIA
detailed_description:
TOHOTOPIA is a lightweight 4X war strategy simulation game based on the world of Touhou Project.
In this grand clash of fantasy and history, the girls from Gensokyo take on the roles of legendary rulers and generals from across human civilization. Lead unique empires inspired by real-world history across a vast tile-based map—explore unknown lands, develop cities, expand territory, and conquer your rivals to achieve ultimate victory.

Gameplay Overview

  • Choose Your Civilization:
    Select one of four initial Gensokyo factions (Palace of the Earth Spirits, Scarlet Devil Mansion, Eientei, Moriya Shrine), each representing a historical empire.
    Every civilization has a distinct visual style and theme.
    Each one is led by five unique “Great Person” units—King, Queen, Rook, Knight, and Minister—represented by iconic Gensokyo girls.

  • Strategic Actions:
    View the world from a top-down perspective. Explore fog-of-war tiles, build cities, manage resources, raise armies, and engage in strategic combat.

  • Victory & Defeat:
    Eliminate all opponents or have the highest score when the game ends to win.
    Lose your last city, and it's game over.

  • Session Duration:
    Each game lasts around 20–30 minutes, perfect for casual play and replayability.

Game Modes

  • Story Mode:
    Complete specific objectives to win each round. Enjoy unique gameplay challenges paired with engaging short stories.

  • Free Mode:
    Customize map size, terrain types, and number of enemies to create your own ideal battlefield.

Achievements & Challenge

The game features a rich and expansive achievement system, encouraging long-term exploration and replay.
Achievements are packed with Touhou trivia and fun facts from various real-world civilizations—deepening both the strategic depth and the creative historical twist of the experience.

Music & Art Style

  • Designed in a Lowpoly aesthetic, the game blends cute and cozy visuals with the magical feel of Gensokyo.

  • Each faction features original Touhou-inspired tracks that reflect the culture and flavor of the civilization it represents—fusing traditional ethnic music with the iconic melodies of Touhou.

Touhou × History: A Fantasy Crossover You Never Expected!

  • Kaguya Houraisan × Napoleon:
    Can the moon princess from Eientei channel the brilliance of the infamous war genius?

  • Remilia Scarlet × Pharaoh Osiris:
    Will the Scarlet Devil rise as a commanding pharaoh under the blessings of the Nile?

  • Sanae Kochiya × Bismarck:
    Can the living goddess of Moriya lead a new iron-fisted empire?

  • Satori Komeiji × Rama:
    Does the mind-reading mistress of the Underworld embody the wisdom of the disciplined Indian king?

The magical blend of Gensokyo heroines with the giants of world history is the soul and charm of TOHOTOPIA.

Demo Content

This Demo features the playable civilization:
Egyptian Empire · Scarlet Dynasty
Under the nourishing waters of the Nile, can Pharaoh Remilia lead the Scarlet Devil Mansion to world domination?

Development Roadmap

  • More Gensokyo × Civilization combinations coming in the full release

  • Additional historical leader × Touhou character pairings

  • Online multiplayer mode

  • Multi-language support

Stay tuned for the full version of Empire Gensokyo ~ TOHOTOPIA!

short_description: A fan-made 4X strategy game based on Touhou Project. Touhou heroines lead fantasy civilizations to explore, build, expand, and conquer. The demo features the Egyptian Empire – Scarlet Dynasty. Can Pharaoh Remilia rule the world? Full version adds more factions, multiplayer, and languages.
